The expand fixture (VLA.3). Each case sits under a line "=== <name>" and
runs to the next such line; these lines before the first header are
ignored. A case's lines are one VLA text, joined with a line break where
there are more than one, expanded to its fixpoint under the prelude as
VlaExpandText (VLA.bas) expands it. VlaWriteExpandGolden (VLA_Tests.bas)
writes every case's record to expand_golden.txt: "EXPANDED<TAB><the macro
applications that fired>" and the text VlaExpandText prints, or
"REFUSED<TAB><the catalogue's id><TAB><the refusal's text>". vla-lang is
held to that file by tests/expand_golden.rs, and
tools/check_expand_golden.ps1 holds the pair's shape and every one of the
twenty-nine expand-time primitives reached, with the walk's forms,
formula-expand and the loop, each and each-index (VLA.5), an entry's parts
named by a loop's list of names (VLA.16), and define and
a reference's two parts, sheet-expand and range-expand, beside the
formula syntax's last (VLA.6), and a reference's first cell,
first-cell-expand, beside the formula syntax's three marks, absolute,
absolute-row and absolute-column (VLA.15), and a macro's named pieces, each
of their refusals among them (VLA.9), and the place a verb writes, the word
self, bind-expand and offset-expand, each of their refusals among them
(VLA.10), and functions at expand time, defexpand, and let-expand, with
a define's word and a call handed in read as values, each of their
refusals among them (VLA.8). A case is named for what it means to reach; the golden records what the reference does. A refusal that names a
line names the case's own, counted from the case's first line, so an edit
of the prelude moves nothing here.

(car (quote (a b c)))

=== cells-written-by-a-walk
(defmacro (cells sheet & entries)
  "value cells of one sheet, named once: each entry an address or a range, then its value"
  (quote-if (null? entries)
    (begin)
    (begin
      (cell sheet (car (car entries)) (car (cdr (car entries))))
      (quasiquote (cells (unquote sheet) (unquote-splicing (cdr entries)))))))
(cells "S"
  ("A1" 1)
  ("B1" 2)
  ("C1:C3" 0))
=== cells-written-by-each
(defmacro (cells sheet & entries)
  "value cells of one sheet, named once: each entry an address or a range, then its value"
  (each (entry entries)
    (cell sheet (car entry) (car (cdr entry)))))
(cells "S"
  ("A1" 1)
  ("B1" 2)
  ("C1:C3" 0))

=== each-index-counts-down-a-block-s-labels
(defmacro (labels sheet first & texts)
  "texts down a column from a cell, one a row: a block's labels"
  (labels-at sheet (row-expand first) (column-expand first) texts))
(defmacro (labels-at sheet top column & texts)
  "labels' rows: a text a row, down from the top row in one column"
  (each-index (row text texts top)
    (cell sheet (address-expand row column) text)))
(labels "Keys" "A3" "up" "down" "left")
=== each-index-counts-the-palette-from-0
(defmacro (palette & entries)
  "the Palette's rows: each entry a color and a name, its index its place from 0"
  (each-index (index entry entries 0)
    (palette-entry index entry)))
(defmacro (palette-entry index entry)
  "one Palette row: the index in column A, the color in column B"
  (cell "Palette" (address-expand (+expand index 1) 1) index)
  (cell "Palette" (address-expand (+expand index 1) 2) (car entry)))
(palette
  ("#000000" "black")
  ("#0000AA" "blue"))
=== each-index-draws-a-picture-a-cell-a-character
(defmacro (picture sheet top left & rows)
  "rows of cells drawn as text: each string a row down from the top, each character a cell, a dot no cell"
  (each-index (row text rows top)
    (each-index (column character (characters-expand text) left)
      (picture-cell sheet row column character))))
(defmacro (picture-cell sheet row column character)
  "one character's cell: a dot writes none, any other character a cell of 1"
  (quote-if (eq? character ".")
    (begin)
    (cell sheet (address-expand row column) 1)))
(picture "S" 2 1
  ".#"
  "#.")

=== each-inside-formula-expand-in-a-template
(defmacro (row-total sheet row & columns)
  "a row's total in column A: the sum of the row's cells in the columns named"
  (formula sheet (address-expand row 1)
    (formula-expand
      (+ (each (column columns)
           (ref sheet (address-expand row (column-expand column))))))))
(row-total "Ledger" 4 "C" "D" "E")

=== each-after-unquote-splicing-splices-its-results

=== each-after-unquote-is-its-list

    (f (unquote (each (x xs) (g x))))))

=== cells-written-by-names
(defmacro (cells sheet & entries)
  "Puts values in cells of one sheet. Each entry is a cell's address, or a range of cells, and the value that goes there."
  (each ((address value) entries)
    (cell sheet address value)))

  ("A1" 1)
  ("B1" 2)
  ("C1:C3" 0))

(defmacro (palette & entries)
  "The Palette's rows. Each entry is a color and its name, and its place counts from 0."
  (each-index (index (color name) entries 0)
    (palette-entry index color name)))
(defmacro (palette-entry index color name)
  "One Palette row: the index in column A, the color in column B, the name in column C."
  (cell "Palette" (address-expand (+expand index 1) 1) index)
  (cell "Palette" (address-expand (+expand index 1) 2) color)
  (cell "Palette" (address-expand (+expand index 1) 3) name))
(palette
  ("#000000" "black")
  ("#0000AA" "blue"))

=== pieces-through-on
(defmacro (on sheet & forms)
  "rows of one sheet, named once: each a call whose first argument is the sheet, written without it"
  (quote-if (null? forms)
    (begin)
    (begin
      (cons (car (car forms)) (cons sheet (cdr (car forms))))
      (quasiquote (on (unquote sheet) (unquote-splicing (cdr forms)))))))

(defmacro (put write-sheet at (sheet "Screen") (value 0))
  "a write of a Write sheet's two columns, each part by its word"
  (cell write-sheet at sheet)
  (formula write-sheet (address-expand (row-expand at) (+expand (column-expand at) 1)) (formula-expand value)))

(on "Write"
  (put "A1" (sheet "Tower"))
  (put "A2" (value 2)))

  "the square of a radius around a cell"

    (-expand 0 radius)

(defmacro (rules sheet & entries)
  "one sheet named once, each entry a place and an expression"
  (quote-if (null? entries)
    (begin)
    (begin
      (rule sheet (car (car entries)) (car (cdr (car entries))))
      (quasiquote (rules (unquote sheet) (unquote-splicing (cdr entries)))))))

(rules "S"
  ("B1" (last self))
  ("B2" (last self))
  ("B3" self))
=== siblings-by-on
(defmacro (rule sheet range expression)
  "one formula row, self its range's first cell"
  (bind-expand ((self (ref sheet (first-cell-expand (ref sheet range)))))
    (formula sheet range (formula-expand expression))))

(defmacro (on sheet & forms)
  "rows of one sheet, each call written without its sheet"
  (quote-if (null? forms)
    (begin)
    (begin
      (cons (car (car forms)) (cons sheet (cdr (car forms))))
      (quasiquote (on (unquote sheet) (unquote-splicing (cdr forms)))))))

(on "S"
  (rule "B1" (last self))
  (rule "B2" (last self)))
